props.title: Installation
props.content:
Install the CLI

One command creates a project with the parches you pick. Nothing is cloned; the CLI fetches the template at the version it was built for.

npm create parche@latest my-site

Connect a repository

Push the folder to a repository and point your host at it. Every page is static unless you add an adapter.

What gets created

A content folder with pages, layouts and navigation as JSON; the parches you chose in astro.config.mjs; and a theme, if you picked one.
